versions.changelog:
**Major update: Enhanced privacy and data handling for student records**

- Added explicit Privacy and Data Handling section to clarify what is stored, where it is saved, and how user data is managed.
- Now informs users the first time data is saved, with instructions for viewing or deletion.
- Limits stored information to only what is essential for college tracking (no sensitive IDs or financial account details).
- Improved user control: users can view or delete all data on request, with confirmation before any deletion.
- Skill triggers only for specific student tracking requests, not for general college questions.
- Streamlined documentation and removed internal evaluation/test files.
v1.0.1 - Documentation cleanup. Frontmatter version quoted for CLI compatibility, added CHANGELOG.md. No behavior changes.

Initial release of College Prep Tracker—track all aspects of the college application process for one or more students.

- Manage student profiles, including GPA, test scores, intended major, and extracurriculars.
- Track college applications, essays (including supplementals), deadlines, and visit notes per student and school.
- Handle scholarships, financial aid (FAFSA/CSS Profile), and per-school aid offers.
- Monitor recommendation letter requests and statuses across all applications.
- Built-in milestone timeline for junior and senior years to guide students step-by-step.
- All data securely saved and updated in a single JSON file for persistence and easy management.
